searchText: Could I get an update from the different client teams how they are coming along with their version releases for devnet 8? We're still looking at the Hive tests. I expect that Erigon won't be ready for devnet 8 this week. We have a draft implementation of all Cancun EIPs besides EIP-6780, but it's far from polished yet. We'll also need to spend some time on blob txpool. any idea when can we have consensus tests released for this Besu is also still working on Hive tests, and do not have an eta on 4788 yet. Likely not ready for 8 this week. Nethermind is mostly ready, a couple of fixes+merge 4788 is expected mid week. The branch/image_tag is `cancun` Devnet 8 readiness (will keep this updated)``` EL: Besu: next week Nethermind: mid week Erigon: next week Ethereumjs: ✅ Geth: ? CL: Lodestar: ✅ Prysm: mid week Lighthouse: mid week Teku: ✅ Nimbus: mid week ``` <dannyryan> working on test vector buidl and CL release right now with hww PSA: EL teams who want to test the Engine API for devnet 8 (4844+4788) please use: https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/engine-api-blobs We are working on deploying this to https://hivecancun.ethdevops.io/ and it will also have most pyspec evm tests when it's ready <dannyryan> CL spec release is out https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.4.0-beta.1 probably midweek for lighthouse Same for prysm Nimbus should be ready around then too For Teku, you can use latest `develop` docker tag. It is ready for devnet8. <@543900561460822016> playing with your latest commit. Got this 🙂 ``` # github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/miner miner/worker.go:939:23: cannot use &genParams.beaconRoot (value of type **"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common".Hash) as *"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common".Hash value in assignment util.go:48: exit status 1 ``` Hey all, preliminary Devnet-8 hive branch with tests including 4844, 4788, 5656 and 6780 can be found here: https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/cancun-dn8-4844-4788 Please check file `./configs/cancun.yaml` to verify that the execution client is using the correct branch for Devnet-8. To run Engine API tests use: ``` ./hive --sim ethereum/engine --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client> --sim.limit "engine-blobs/" ``` To run execution spec tests (EVM tests) use: ``` ./hive --sim ethereum/pyspec --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client> ``` EVM tests are the ones included in this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/223 EIP-1153 will be included later this week, and if you need any help running the tests please let me or <@755913785620824175> know 🙌 (This is execution layer tests only for now)

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Hey all, preliminary Devnet-8 hive branch with tests including 4844, 4788, 5656 and 6780 can be found here:
https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/cancun-dn8-4844-4788

Please check file `./configs/cancun.yaml` to verify that the execution client is using the correct branch for Devnet-8.

To run Engine API tests use:
```
./hive --sim ethereum/engine --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client> --sim.limit "engine-blobs/"
```

To run execution spec tests (EVM tests) use:
```
./hive --sim ethereum/pyspec --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client>
```

EVM tests are the ones included in this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/223

EIP-1153 will be included later this week, and if you need any help running the tests please let me or <@755913785620824175> know 🙌
(This is execution layer tests only for now)
